end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance food travels to reach us.
Identified checking packaging to find a food’s origin.
Suggested local and seasonal food can reduce fuel use and pollution.
Discussed spinach from a nearby farm and apples from cooler places.
Teach-back was not passed; the belief that imported food is always better remained at the end.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised finding where food comes from and linking shorter journeys with less fuel use and pollution. They used examples such as nearby spinach, local tomatoes, and seasonal mangoes. Rohan mixed up the idea that imported food is always more nutritious; this was not corrected by the last time it appeared. At home, ask them to compare two foods by checking their labels and discussing distance, season, freshness, and limits such as food availability.
